Kforce has a client that is seeking a Forward Deployed AI Engineer in Hollywood, FL (Florida).

Summary:
We are seeking a highly technical and solutions-oriented Software Engineer to help identify, design, and implement technology solutions that improve business processes and operational efficiency. This is not a traditional software engineering, AI engineering, or data science position. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering capabilities with business acumen and enjoys working directly with operational teams to understand complex challenges and build practical solutions. The Engineer will evaluate opportunities to leverage technologies such as AI, software automation, and robotics to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and support innovation across diverse business environments.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  Partner with business and operational teams to identify processes that can be optimized through technology 
  Design and implement practical software solutions that improve efficiency and solve real-world business problems 
  Evaluate opportunities to apply AI, automation, robotics, and other advanced technologies to business and manufacturing processes 
  Translate operational challenges into clear technical solutions and implementation plans 
  Develop solutions that balance technical capabilities, business requirements, scalability, and cost 
  Work directly with individual business units to understand their processes, challenges, and technology needs 
  Build, test, implement, and continuously improve technology solutions 
  Adapt solutions to different operating environments rather than relying on a one-size-fits-all approach 
  Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive initiatives from concept through implementation 
  Research and evaluate emerging technologies that could improve business operations 
  Travel to operating locations to assess business needs and support implementation 
 
 
  1 to 5 years of software engineering or related technical experience 
  Experience designing or building technology solutions that address operational or business challenges 
  Strong software development and engineering fundamentals 
  Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities 
  Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders 
  Intellectual curiosity and a strong interest in emerging technologies 
  Hands-on builder mentality with the ability to take ideas from concept through implementation 
  Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar business processes and operating environments 
  Ability to combine technical expertise with business problem-solving skills 
  Ability and willingness to travel approximately 50% 
  Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information 

 
Preferred Qualifications:
 
  Experience with AI-enabled solutions, automation, or robotics 
  Experience applying technology to manufacturing, operations, or business process optimization 
  Strong computer science or engineering educational background 
  Experience evaluating new technologies and determining their practical business applications 
  Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a newly created role 
  Demonstrated passion for technology through personal projects, open-source contributions, robotics, technical competitions, or similar work
